تلتحمي (form VIII)
# تَلْتَحِمِي (taltaḥimī) /tal.ta.ħi.miː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
# تُلْتَحَمِي (tultaḥamī) /tul.ta.ħa.miː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَمَ (iltaḥama)
